entry.summary: The rapid shift from passive conversational chatbots to active operational agents has changed the software engineering landscape. Modern systems powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) do not simply display answers. When a standard application breaks, a developer can follow a deterministic trace through structured code pathways. entry.summary:
The problem: your voice agent is ready, but India won't pick up
You have a working voice AI agent — maybe built on LiveKit Agents, Vapi, or Retell — and you need it to be reachable on a real Indian phone number.
